Hi Jordan / team,

- Resume attached (PDF).
- Timezone: EDT (UTC-4). Eden is available: Mon Mar 1 (10:00–13:00 PST), Tue Mar 2 (12:00–16:00 PST) and Wed Mar 3 (flex).

We typically run a 2-part 90-minute loop (45m coding modeling challenge + 45m systems/design/debrief). Suggested slot: Mon Mar 1 at 11:00 PST. Candidate prefers earlier in the week.

Platform: we can use CoderPad (temporary session below) and give interviewers a shared drive doc for notes.
CoderPad: https://coderpad.io/sessions/9f3a2b
Shared notes folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cHiringDocs

Attachment: Eden_Park_Resume.pdf (pdf)

Can you confirm who can take which half? Quick asks:
- Who can run the modeling/code task? (we need someone comfortable reviewing NumPy/PyTorch snippets)
- Who will drive the systems/design/debrief?
- Can someone own the post-interview debrief doc?

Thanks — I can hold the candidate slot once you confirm times.

Best,

Thanks Mina — and hi all.

I'll take the modeling/code portion if the slot is at 11:00 PST on Mon Mar 1. Lauren, would you be able to take the systems/design + debrief? Kimberly, can you own the post-interview rubric and consolidate notes?

Plan proposal (if 11:00 PST works):
- 11:00–11:05: quick intros and context (Jordan)
- 11:05–11:50: modeling/code (45m) — live CoderPad (I will prepare the starter pad; please use the same session link)
- 11:50–12:35: systems/design + product tradeoffs (45m) — Lauren
- 12:35–12:45: brief on-the-spot debrief + next steps (All)

Interviewer notes & template: used the shared Drive folder Mina linked for the rubric. Please add notes directly to the candidate doc during/after the session so recruiting can triage.
Hiring tools & links (internal):
- CoderPad session (use for both rounds): https://coderpad.io/sessions/9f3a2b
- Shared notes: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cHiringDocs (please create a file Eden_Park_Debrief.md inside)
- Calendar event (please accept when invite arrives): https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123def456

If any timing conflicts, suggest the closest alternative within candidate availability window.

On attachments: I reviewed the resume attached; looks like strong research + infra background. I will seed a small pyTorch snippet in the pad to validate model-thinking rather than low-level API memorization.

Jordan Blake
